messages.website.player-guides.6009aeadbc: A future update will add accounts and cross-device save sync so you can continue on another computer. For now, saves stay in this browser and cannot be uploaded or loaded elsewhere. Release notes will explain how sync works when it becomes available.
messages.website.player-guides.822ce9484a: Can I play on a Mac?
messages.website.player-guides.5dc658b65f: Yes. Open BackMir in your Mac’s browser; no Windows launcher, virtual machine or dual-boot setup is needed. Use a current browser with a keyboard and mouse. Your first visit still needs an internet connection to load the game.
messages.website.player-guides.ef99c8ad4f: Is this a solo game or an online multiplayer game?
messages.website.player-guides.d8a2462737: The current game is a solo adventure with three classes: Warrior, Wizard and Taoist. Progress through quests, combat, equipment and exploration. Multiplayer parties, sieges and player trading are not available.
messages.website.player-guides.eb85ae038e: What has changed from the classic game?
messages.website.player-guides.d2624da98c: The three classes, loot hunting, skill progression and map exploration remain at its heart. This H5 version adds guided first skills, expanded random affixes and equipment progression adjustments. Use the current game’s data for exact values.
messages.website.player-guides.1fc14bf22d: Can I move my save to another computer?
messages.website.player-guides.0bc2d8f80f: Can I play offline? Does the game keep running after I close it?
messages.website.player-guides.ec3ce8a476: Downloaded content can be used offline; maps you have not downloaded still need a connection. The System menu offers a full offline download. Closing the page stops the game, so there is no offline farming or automatic income.
messages.website.player-guides.2e801c311f: Do I need to pay or register?
messages.website.player-guides.883f508814: The game is currently free to play, with no registration or paid membership. Any future ads or membership plans will be announced separately. You can start playing now.
messages.website.player-guides.82a56cfc0e: Play BackMir on Mac: The Browser Guide
messages.website.player-guides.a77364cd46: Mac macOS MacBook browser RPG no installation no virtual machine Safari Chrome
messages.website.player-guides.1c6ac82254: BackMir is a classic solo RPG that runs in your browser. Learn how to start on a Mac, use keyboard and mouse controls, and keep your local save without installing a Windows launcher.
messages.website.player-guides.8712947a8d: Open backmir.org in a normal window of your usual browser, choose Start Game, pick a class and create a character. The first launch downloads the game and its resources; wait for loading to finish. You do not need a Windows game client or your own server.
messages.website.player-guides.d137899459: Is There a Separate Mac App?
messages.website.player-guides.5ccdccf0bf: This is the H5 browser version; there is no separate macOS installer. BackMir does not require a virtual machine, dual boot or an Android emulator. It is a browser game, not a tool for running other games’ Windows launchers.
messages.website.player-guides.67e17cf40f: A keyboard and mouse are recommended. Click the game area before using shortcuts. On some Mac keyboards, brightness and volume controls take priority over function keys: try holding Fn, or click the on-screen skill buttons. Trackpad users need a way to right-click. See the in-game controls for the current bindings.
messages.website.player-guides.0f56f275af: Slow Loading or an Unresponsive Screen
messages.website.player-guides.f099c91eaa: The first launch and visits to new areas download resources. Check your connection and try the same address again. You can also download the full offline resources from the game. Use a browser that still receives updates. Avoid clearing site data as a first troubleshooting step: it may delete your saves. Older systems and every browser combination have not all been tested.
messages.website.player-guides.1b1a4ddecc: Why Is My Character Missing in Another Browser?
messages.website.player-guides.324305871b: Different browsers, browser profiles and private windows do not share local saves, even on the same Mac. Return to backmir.org using the browser and profile where you created the character. Signing into a browser account or enabling system sync does not sync your game saves.

messages.website.player-guides.cf0056e500: Warriors rely on close-range sword skills, Wizards on ranged spells, and Taoists on summons and support. Each needs different equipment, supplies and skills. Complete Provisions for the Road to learn your first class skill, then follow the quests into the wider game.
messages.website.player-guides.3f9ea34e84: Single-Player Does Not Mean Fully Offline from the Start

Cached content can keep working offline; uncached content needs a connection. Use Download for Offline Play in the System menu and wait for it to finish. If the browser clears the cache, you must download those resources again.

messages.website.player-guides.7bf4804fd8: BackMir keeps the classic three-class adventure, loot hunting and exploration, with H5 adjustments to new-player guidance and equipment progression. See how it plays and how it differs from older guides.
messages.website.player-guides.044ca5673c: The familiar rhythm remains: choose a Warrior, Wizard or Taoist, learn skills, stock up on potions, find map entrances, defeat monsters and choose what equipment to keep. Solo play lets you explore at your own pace, without waiting for a party or competing for bosses.
messages.website.player-guides.3f940037c2: This version keeps that foundation while adjusting progression. Changes include guided first skills for new characters, more random affixes, revised exceptional drops and high-star affix chances, and clearer set-bonus displays. It does not reproduce every value from a single historical client version.
messages.website.player-guides.3b5c82288f: Why Stars Are Only Part of the Story
messages.website.player-guides.40712ca214: Identical items can roll different exceptional stats and affixes. More stars do not guarantee a better fit for your class. Compare Attack, Magic, Taoism, recovery, skill bonuses and equipment requirements together. The showcase includes real panels from three-star to eight-star items.
messages.website.player-guides.c1aa04c119: Sets and Forging Give You a Next Goal
messages.website.player-guides.9335a5dff7: Set bonuses list their requirements: active bonuses are highlighted and incomplete ones stay grey. Forging and Pandora’s Box recipes have material, Gold and other requirements. Having materials does not guarantee success or a specific stat. Check the recipe before choosing what to keep, craft or replace.
messages.website.player-guides.c18574fb7e: More Than a Promise of Better Drops
messages.website.player-guides.83fd291332: Longer-term goals include skills, exploration, boss fights and equipment builds. Some stages still require gathering supplies, materials and XP. There is no promise of finishing in a few hours, endless content or effortless progression. Try the opening quests, then compare late-game footage and equipment to judge the pace for yourself.
messages.website.player-guides.127004fcb5: How Do Older BackMir Guides Apply?
messages.website.player-guides.925ccddb28: The game draws on BackMir’s original systems, but this website follows the current H5 data and implemented changes. Older guides may describe different skills, controls, map requirements or save procedures. Use this version’s guide and in-game prompts when they differ.
